title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E19 — Pros and Convicts
When Vanessa shows Geneva how to have a good time, Geneva hits on a police officer who mistakes them both as prostitutes. They both are arrested, and Mark is arrested while trying to bail them out of jail.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E20 — Double Cheeseburger, Hold the Diploma
P.J. threatens to discharge Mark when his student, Earvin, quits school. Geneva can't afford to buy a new bicycle for her daughter, Nicole.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E21 — Groom and Doom
Mark introduces Geneva to a college teacher who asks her to marry him.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E22 — Hangin' with Mrs. Cooper
Mark plots to reunite his parents after his mother, Dorothy (Ja'net DuBois), leaves her husband of 35 years and moves in with Mark. Richard Roundtree guest stars.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E3 — The Party’s Over (Here)
Unable to resist the temptations of college life, Moesha and Niecy become regulars on the party circuit, until their attendance at a late-night frat party takes its toll in more ways than one.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E4 — Mis-Directed Study
Moesha is flying high after she gets a job tutoring one of the basketball team’s star players until she finds out what kind of game he really wants to play.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E5 — Not My Pumpkin
Things get tense at the Mitchell house when Frank discovers Moesha has been taking birth control pills – and he’s the last to know.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E6 — Just Above My Head
Moesha finds her history teacher’s remarks racially offensive, but fears that confronting him might affect her grade and cost Niecy her scholarship.

title: My Wife and Kids
description:

Junior's scheme backfires after he forges an A in math.

title: My Wife and Kids

Michael hires an attractive math tutor for Michael Jr.

title: My Wife and Kids
description:

Michael advises his son to fight his school bully with words.

title: My Wife and Kids
description:
S1 E8 — He Said, She Said
Michael and Janet are both guilty of not listening.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E8 — The Big How To Do And Undo It Episode
When Spencer has trouble dumping his new girlfriend, he enlists Dee Dee's help breaking the news. After Phyllis's new boyfriend plans a romantic weekend away, she turns to an unlikely source for help with her sex life.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E9 — The Big Days Of Wine And Neuroses Episode
Dee Dee invites Mona to a 'girl's weekend' at the spa, but Mona soon discovers her sister has an ulterior motive. Spencer's view of the gay world is changed when he spends the weekend with Adam's well connected friends.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E10 — The Big Sexism And The City Episode
When Dee Dee complains her new co-worker, Brett, is questioning her ability to do her job because she is a woman, Charles and Spencer decide they need to intervene on her behalf.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E11 — The Big Sweet Smell Of Success Episode
To boost her spirits from her failing acting career, Big Dee Dee decides to throw a big Legends Ball. Mona begins to worry that her new relationship with Chase is only based on the physical.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E11 — Christmas '95
A trip to a nostalgic tree farm is ruined for Mark and his friends until they all learn the true meaning of Christmas.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E12 — Increase the Peace
Earvin is challenged by a gang member, and Mark intervenes. Raven appears in this episode.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E13 — Robo Golf
Mark makes a risky investment. MARK LINN-BAKER guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E14 — Coach Counselor
Mark loses his office and Geneva promises him another--for a price.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E15 — Talent Show
Mark's a hero when he gets a famous musical group to promise to perform at the school carnival--until they fail to show up. TYRESE guest stars as Darrell.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E16 — Globetrotters
THE HARLEM GLOBETROTTERS (themselves) are playing in town, but Mark might have to miss them.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E17 — Rivals
Mark's competition with a rival coach escalates to a life-threatening degree. JAMIE FOXX guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E18 — The Curse
Mark doesn't believe the great car he just bought is haunted--until bad luck starts happening to him and everyone around him.
